build_pt_transform: build a preprocessing transform pipeline that resizes, converts to tensor, and normalizes images for DINO inference
load_pretrained_dino_weights: load pretrained DINO teacher encoder weights from a PyTorch state dict file into a model
forward_dino: run inference with DINO models to extract patch-wise features from an input image
initialize_webssl_dino_model: initialize a webssl DINO vision transformer model such as webssl_dino7b_full8b_518 from dinov2
compare_hf_pytorch_dino_outputs: compare patch feature outputs between HuggingFace Dinov2Model and PyTorch webssl DINO model implementations
